name: Comedy Inc.
summary: Comedy Inc. was an Australian sketch comedy television series featuring predominantly send-ups and impersonations of well known personalities and TV Shows.

name: Anne Yarısı
summary: The series will bring to the screen the emotionally charged story of Ali and Zeynep, whose paths cross around the same child after a great loss eight years ago. Woven with secrets from the past, a custody battle, and great sacrifices, the series will take the audience on a compelling journey.

name: Still Water
summary:
The small town of Wari Pasop appears peaceful, but beneath its calm surface lie dark secrets and buried truths. Years after a woman mysteriously disappeared, a series of brutal murders brings the old case back to life.

When Pin arrives in Wari Pasop searching for her missing sister Pan, she instead discovers the body of a powerful man's son. As the police investigate, Pin becomes entangled with Jeans, a mysterious newcomer whose secrets may be connected to the murders.

As the investigation unfolds, the town's seemingly ordinary residents become suspects, and trust becomes increasingly difficult. Everyone appears to have something to hide, while the truth behind the disappearances and killings draws closer to the surface.

name: Capricho
summary: Eugenia is a bitter businesswoman who has two daughters. She loves one, Raquel and despises the younger one. The "whim" that the titles refers to is Eugenia's decisions to protect Raquel that end up blowing up in her face.

name: Pampa ilusión
summary: A passionate story where love does not respect traditions and usually breaks with the patterns of the time, all framed in the Chilean nitrate Pampa Ilusión.

name: Estúpido Cupido
summary: In 1962, the small town of San Andrés is governed by morality and good manners, the arrival of a new nun will come to change everything.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final: La decisión de la hermana Angélica

name: Estúpido Cupido
summary: In the 1960s, the lives of several Catholic school students unfold as they romance, party to the American rock and roll craze, and live through high society's prejudices of the times.

name: Sucupira
summary: Tells the story of a coastal resort in some corner of Chile, ruled by Don Federico Valdivieso, a scoundrel mayor, and with the desire to achieve his only goal: a cemetery for his city.

previousepisode.name: 108 Final. La muerte de Federico Valdivieso

name: Η Πολυκατοικία
summary: The every day life and relationship between the rather curious residents of a block of flats in the center of Athens.

previousepisode.name: Itan kapote ena telos kai mia arhi...

name: Aquelarre
summary: In a town towards the south central of Chile, a strange mystery occurs, for years only women are born.

name: Los Pincheira
summary: Los Pincheira follows four siblings who form a legendary band of outlaws to seek justice against the tyrannical landowners responsible for their father's wrongful execution.

name: El Circo de las Montini
summary: El Circo de las Montini tells the story of Olga Primera Montini—the matriarch and owner of a circus troupe setting up in San Antonio—as she prepares to hand over control to one of her four daughters, all while a past love reappears, bringing with him secrets from the past.

name: Decision House
summary: Decision House is a reality television series in which couples enter on-camera therapy to save marriages. It debuted on MyNetworkTV in September 2007 and aired for only one season.

name: Evadidos
summary: Evadidos is set in an alternate 1980s Portugal where a repressive, authoritarian dictatorship took over much of the world following World War II. The plot follows a protagonist living in the shadows who helps dissidents escape the oppressive regime.

name: Pobre Clara
summary: A mature woman—who possesses the withdrawn personality of a 14-year-old due to the psychological abuse inflicted by her controlling mother—breaks free from her emotional shackles when she embarks on an unexpected journey and meets a distinguished doctor who helps her discover her true worth.

name: Till I See You
summary: Song Yi, a wealthy young man raised in Japan, travels to Northern China in search of answers about his father's past and unexpectedly becomes Xu Feiyu's temporary caregiver. Recovering from eye surgery with his eyes still covered in bandages, Feiyu slowly lowers his guard under Song Yi's domineering yet tender care. Before they can truly ""see"" each other, they have already fallen in love. But just as Feiyu is about to regain his sight, a devastating secret comes to light, forcing Song Yi to disappear without a word. Five years later, fate brings them together again. Can their unforgettable love finally be made whole?

name: Iorana
summary: Cristián and the beautiful Pasquense Vaitea decide to get married, but numerous obstacles stand in the way of their happiness, the most important of which is the return of Cristián's father, Fernando Balbontín, who escaped from Rapa Nui 15 years earlier accused of a crime he did not commit.

name: Amor Descarado
summary: Amor Descarado is a Telemundo telenovela that tells the story of twin brothers separated at birth—leading completely opposite lives—who accidentally swap identities.

name: O Bem-Amado
summary: Mayor Odorico Paraguaçu—a corrupt politician full of schemes—has made the inauguration of the local cemetery the top priority of his administration in the fictional town of Sucupira, on the coast of Bahia, deciding to follow the example set by his father, Odorico I. He is fawned over by his stuttering secretary, Dirceu Borboleta—an expert on lepidoptera—and enjoys the unconditional support of the Cajazeira sisters, his political allies and fervent defenders: Doroteia, Dulcineia, and Judiceia.

name: Lo que es el amor
summary: Lo que es el amor follows the lives, conflicts, and diverse romantic perspectives of a group of men and women in Mexico City who seek to understand the true meaning of romantic relationships.

name: Dulce Ana
summary: For years, Ana lives as an undervalued servant to her overbearing mother, Mariana, completely unaware that her real biological mother was actually Mariana's deceased sister, Victoria. When a compassionate aunt gifts her a life-changing vacation, Ana meets a man who falls in love with her sweet nature. This romance triggers a complete personal and physical transformation, forcing her to return home and fight back against her mother's attempts to destroy her newfound happiness.

name: Szeret, nem szeret
summary: The daily life of a young couple—filled with humor and arguments—revolving around the eternal questions of male-female relationships, ranging from the toothpaste tube to the challenges of marriage.

name: Love Warriors
summary: Two ambitious professionals navigating the cutthroat corporate world find their competitive dynamic shifting into deep personal tension and unexpected romance as they confront hidden feelings and workplace boundaries.

name: A Indomável
summary: Gustavo accepts the mission of winning over Catarina, a young feminist who loathes men and marriage in exchange for a fortune offered by her father.

name: Şaşıfelek Çıkmazı
summary: This nostalgic series, shedding light on 1990s Turkey, offers a heartwarming family atmosphere. Şaşıfelek Çıkmazı, the main setting for most of the series, is a place filled with people leading simple yet colorful lives, including a grocer, butcher, snack bar owner, and more. Inci, who returned to Şaşıfelek Çıkmazı years after leaving her family, opens a new chapter in her life with the friendly neighborhood residents she's known since childhood. A humorous drama about intimate neighborhood relationships in an old neighborhood in Istanbul.

name: La pobre Clara
summary:
La pobre Clara revolves around Clara Escobar, a woman caught in a gray and submissive life. Marked by the rejection of her own family, Clara is treated practically as a servant by her authoritarian and selfish mother, living isolated from the world, withdrawn and with a destroyed self-esteem .

The break point occurs when Clara makes a trip to Europe. There she meets Dr. Christian Carriel, an affable man who sees beyond her sloppy appearance and extreme shyness. Christian sincerely falls in love with her, teaching her to value herself .Throughout history, Clara goes through a radical transformation: she leaves behind her fears, frees herself from the family yoke and returns to become a confident, elegant and willing woman to fight for her own happiness and love.

name: Heredot Cevdet Saati
summary: Inspired by the stories of the legendary character Herodotus Cevdet, this series is a continuation of the beloved Ekmek Teknesi (The Bread Boat). Blending comedy and drama, Herodotus is famous for the stories he tells every evening in the neighborhood coffeehouse. No matter the time period in which they take place, his tales are told as if they happened just hours ago. His nickname comes from Herodotus, one of the oldest known historians.

name: Al derecho y al Derbez
summary: Mexican comedian Eugenio Derbez showcases his comedic versatility through a fast-paced variety show filled with humorous sketches, recurring eccentric characters, short jokes, and special guest appearances.

name: Ekmek Teknesi
summary: Painting a heartwarming family portrait featuring the baker Nusret Baba, his wife Ayhan Hanım, and their delightful daughters, Ekmek Teknesi (The Bread Boat) chronicles the lives, joys, sorrows, struggles, and romances of a modest, unassuming middle-class neighborhood. Set in one of Istanbul's most vibrant neighborhoods—populated by characters like Heredot Cevdet, Ruhi the hardware store owner, the barber, Kirli, and Cengiz—the series blends charming, heartfelt stories with humor. Baker Nusret Efendi has five daughters... He leads a happy, contented life with his wife and five girls... For years, Nusret Efendi and his wife Ayhan Hanım have served as the neighborhood's parental figures... Everyone in the neighborhood trusts Nusret Efendi's words and holds him in high regard... The local community is made up of charming and eccentric individuals... While each has their own amusing story and life, their defining bond is that they live together... *Ekmek Teknesi* is the tale of an old Istanbul neighborhood—a story that, while fictional, is so beautiful one wishes it were real...

name: Timmy and Vicki
summary: Timmy and Vicki is a two-part play about two young teenagers navigating their first serious relationship, with each episode told from one of their points of view.

name: Doc
summary: The gentle humor of old-fashioned family doctor Joe Bogert.

name: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
summary:
Historians Dan Snow and Professor Suzannah Lipscomb investigate the lives and deaths of some of Tudor England's most fascinating figures, including Anne Boleyn, Mary, Queen of Scots, and Perkin Warbeck, who claimed to be one of the famed Princes in the Tower. 

Dan and Suzie seek clues in spectacular castles and palaces across Britain and rest of Europe, gain rare access to archives, and reveal new evidence that helps expose the truth behind the executions. Were these iconic figures architects of their own downfall or casualties of ruthless political power plays? 

The series combines cinematic storytelling with cutting-edge research as we reassess some of the Tudor era's most notorious, controversial and misunderstood individuals. If you want to understand the Tudors, get to know who they executed - and why.

nextepisode.name: Earl of Essex – Fall of a Favourite

name: Japan's Wild Side
summary:
Japan is famous for its rich traditions and futuristic cities, but it is also a nation bursting with unbelievable wildlife. On this journey from the archipelago's harsh winters through the summer mating season, meet endemic species like bears, raccoons, crabs, flying squirrels, foxes and eagles. 

Witness never-before-seen footage of Japanese cranes' courting ritual, the spawning of the endangered Japanese giant salamander, battles between Ezo sables, and the flight of the Sika deer.

name: The Bodies on the Bridge
summary:
In July 2024, the discovery of two suitcases containing human remains on Bristol's iconic Clifton Suspension Bridge shocked the nation and sparked one of the UK's most disturbing murder investigations in recent memory. 

The Bodies on the Bridge follows the investigation from the moment police are alerted to a man wheeling a heavy suitcase across a bridge in the early hours of the morning. When officers discover human remains inside two abandoned suitcases, detectives launch an urgent hunt to identify the victims and track down the person responsible. 

With unprecedented access to the court proceedings, investigators, police officers, journalists and friends connected to the case, the two-part special explores the murders of Albert Alfonso and Paul Longworth and uncovers their complex relationship with Yostin Mosquera, who was found guilty of the murders of the pair.

name: Operation Homeland
summary: Operation Homeland takes viewers inside ICE operations across America, following officers as they track violent offenders, fugitives, and national security threats. With unprecedented access, the series captures high-risk arrests, border operations and the growing challenges officers face, revealing the people, pressure and consequences behind one of America's most controversial missions.

name: Você Decide
summary: A TV show that presents dramatic stories where the viewer has the opportunity to call the TV station and choose the ending of the story, since there were always two filmed endings. Different hosts through the years would present the situation the viewers were about to see, then display the network numbers so they would pick their favorite ending to the plot.

name: O Dono do Mundo
summary: The unethical plastic surgeon Felipe Barreto, married out of interest to Stella, daughter of the wealthy businessman Herculano Maciel, feels a strong attraction to Márcia, a simple, shy, suburban teacher, engaged to Walter, an employee at his clinic. This fascination increases when he discovers that the girl is a virgin. In order to make love to the girl before her fiancé, he arranges for Walter to distance himself and seduces Márcia when she seeks him out. In fact, the girl, before her wedding night, ends up surrendering to Felipe, which causes her life to fall apart, which makes her dedicate herself solely to revenge against the doctor.

name: O Salvador da Pátria
summary: Innocent farm worker Sassá Mutema becomes the town hero and a political candidate after he's wrongfully accused of murdering a famous radio broadcaster who used his radio program to deceive and manipulate his listeners.

name: Saramandaia
summary: The choice of a new city name ignites political conflict in a small town where many of the citizens display unusual, strange abilities - such as a man with wings, a werewolf professor and a woman who literally blows up for overeating.

name: Roque Santeiro
summary: After being presumed dead, a messianic figure returns to the small city he once helped to defend from a criminal mob, shaking everyone's lives up.

name: Pedra Sobre Pedra
summary: Resplendor, in the Northeastern hinterland, was the stage for political disputes between the Pontes and the Batista families. This rivalry led to a complicated web of love, betrayal, and hidden secrets among its members over the years.

name: O Cravo e a Rosa
summary: A spoiled feminist, daughter of a rich father, even though she doesn't admit it, falls in love with a rustic farmer whom she marries.

name: Hombre tenías que ser
summary: Raquel Lomelí, a beautiful and cultured young woman, gets ahead without her father's help. She works as an associate at the Lara and Lomelí agency. During an earthquake she meets Román Ortega and he falls in love with her, but what he doesn't know is that Raquel is the daughter of Emiliano Lomelí, "El Tiburon": a cold and unscrupulous man who has stripped engineer Jorge Lara of his property and health, a man whom Roman admires in every way, without knowing that he is actually his father.

name: Lo que callamos las mujeres
summary: Every chapter takes a different case, all related to what women go through in life, their experiences, their decisions and how sometimes women silence themselves when they are abused, or sometimes they abuse their children for the wrong reasons.

name: Get Me Out of Here
summary: An updated and amped-up take on the massive series "I'm a Celebrity... Get Me Out of Here!" the series is set in a dense and unforgiving jungle, pairing celebrities with a non-famous friend or family member in the ultimate test of friendship.

name: Victoria
summary: After the death of her mother, a determined young Chicana woman relocates from Los Angeles to Mexico alongside her ailing sister to claim a rightful inheritance, only to become entangled in an unexpected web of romance and elite family drama.

name: Bizimkiler
summary: Relationships of neighbours living in an apartment in Istanbul.

name: La hora pico
summary: Sketches and gags of various genres of humor, such as black, urban, white, double sense and dawn. Without ridiculing, offending or ridiculing anyone. A program for the whole family that also addressed issues of general interest.

name: Da dragi da draga
summary: A couple in their mid-thirties navigates everyday life, proving that opposite views on minor problems lead to funny arguments and a deep, lasting love.

name: Tenías que ser tú
summary: Tenías que ser tú centers on Marisa, a determined single mother who moves to Mexico City, where her life takes a romantic turn after she meets a man who becomes the father her daughter always wanted.

name: Tenías que ser tú
summary: The story follows Gabriela Beltrán, whose life changes dramatically after the tragic death of her father leaves her family in poverty. As she and her family struggle to rebuild their lives, Gabriela falls in love with her childhood friend, Gorka Charachaga. Their romance is threatened by Santa, an ambitious young woman determined to separate them, leading to a story of love, sacrifice, and perseverance in the face of adversity.

name: Renze
summary: Every weekday, Renze Klamer discusses the day's news from the Netherlands and abroad with relevant guests. The show combines current topics, thought-provoking conversations, and a friendly, relaxed atmosphere.

name: Minute to Win It
summary: Minute to Win It was a game show where people would compete in stunts to win $250,000. They could include pulling all the tissues out of a box with one hand, stacking golf balls, but they all featured household items.

name: The Harry Hill Show
summary: Hello there! It's me, Harry Hill! I've got a new show, and this time, it's visualised, A VODSCARF. Join me, my son Gary and Sarah the A.I Bot as we talk to a motley crew of comedians, celebrities and cultural icons, and if that wasn't enough we all learn together as we speak to an expert on stuff like the big bang, day of the dead, and even FLIES as part of our theme of the week! PLUS introducing the game everyone is talking about, Name The Seed

name: My Ex-boyfriend Is An Idol
summary: Namthap, a successful young idol unexpectedly reunites with his missing ex-boyfriend, Karant, and is determined not to let him go a second time.

name: Знахарка
summary: The young and beautiful Lesya has a rare gift: she can heal people, curing even those illnesses that modern medicine cannot handle. Lesya's gift is hereditary: both her late mother and her grandmother, with whom Lesya lives in an old village house, were healers. One day, a wealthy businessman, Arkady, arrives in the village, having given up hope of curing his injury. Lesya cures his illness. Arkady and Lesya fall in love with each other, and Arkady proposes to the girl. It would seem that Lesya's fate has been happily resolved: a life in the city, in a luxurious apartment, with a loving husband… But Lesya's grandmother is in despair. She is the only one who knows: Lesya's gift will be lost in the city.

name: Τι ψυχή θα παραδώσεις μωρή;
summary: Four women who grew up in an orphanage reunite after many years with one common goal; to take revenge on the man who abused them when they were little girls.

name: Δύο Ξένοι
summary: Konstadinos Markoras is a director who owns a high profile drama school. Marina Kountouratou is a beautiful woman who hosts a silly television show. Seeking to improve her image, Marina decides to go for studies at Konstadino's school, so that people will stop thinking she's a dumb blonde. Konstadinos doesn't welcome the crazy girl at his school and soon tension begins to raise between them.

name: S' agapo - M' agapas
summary: Thodoris Atheridis and Dimitra Papadopoulou are back with new web episodes of "I Love You, You Love Me," every Thursday at 3:00 p.m., exclusively on COSMOTE's YouTube channel. The beloved next-door couple is back—and they're totally digital! Where are Dimitra and Thodoris 17 years later? Are they still together? Do they have kids? What's their relationship with technology and social media? If you loved the TV series, then don't miss its online adaptation!

name: Εγκλήματα
summary: Alekos falls in love with a married woman, Flora, and therefore his wife is tempted to kill him. Meanwhile, many other figures are entering the plot, who is totally unsuspected or maybe not.

name: Οι στάβλοι της Εριέτας Ζαΐμη
summary: Dimitris Pavlatos is a supervisor trying to improve the conditions in Kalamos female prison, but he falls in love with a prisoner.

name: Η οικογένεια βλάπτει
summary: A family sitcom concerning a guy next door who falls in love with the wrong girl and is forced to move in with one of the most dysfunctional families ever: The Trambalis. Her father is a con artist, her mother simply adores her ex and is doing all she can to get them back together, her brother is insanely stupid, his kids are constantly trying to escape from the madhouse and her aunt simply wants any man available. The owner of this 4 generations house is the grandfather who's looking for ways to kick them all out of his house, sell it and move to Russia with his young Russian girlfriend.

name: Μην αρχίζεις τη μουρμούρα
summary: Season 1-3: Three couples in their early thirties, mid forties and mid sixties are in Athens. Season 4: Three couples in their early twenties, mid thirties and mid forties are in Athens and one couple in their mid sixties is in Crete. Season 5: Two couples in their early thirties and mid forties are in Athens, one couple in their early forties is in Thessaloniki and one couple in their mid sixties is in Crete. Also one extra couple in the Cypriot edition. Season 6: One couple in their thirties is in Athens, two in their forties - one in Thessaloniki and one in Pirgos - and one in their sixties in Crete. Also two extra couples in the Cypriot edition. Season 7-8-9: One couple in their thirties is in Athens, two in their forties - one in Thessaloniki and one in Pirgos - and one in their sixties in Crete. The Cypriot stories were concluded after two years by the end of the sixth season.

name: Δέκα Λεπτά Κήρυγμα
summary: Leonidas is a high-school student who hates studying and enjoys rebel life. How can he and his friends and girlfriend cope with his divorced parents and meddling grandmother, who just can't help interfering in her lives?

name: The Mad Monk: Subdue Demons
summary: The Mad Monk wanders the mortal realm, guiding and saving those in need, only to find himself trapped in a fateful love tribulation. When he reunites with a woman from his past, the two are drawn into a tangled struggle of love and hatred as demonic forces unleash chaos upon the world. Between the playful daily life of Lingyin Temple and a deadly clash between the divine and the demonic, he must see through greed, anger, delusion, and delusive thoughts. Amid joys and sorrows, partings and reunions, he battles the forces of evil to restore peace to the mortal world.

name: Το καφέ της Χαράς
summary: This series takes place at the isolated village of Kolokotronitsi, a place where life has stuck some decades ago. When Hara, a young woman from Athens comes to the village and opens a cafe, a conflict occurs between her and the totally conservative mayor, Periandros, who doesn't want the ideals and ethic of his village to be destroyed. On the 4th season the series concentrates in the love of Hara's daughter and Periandros' son and the opening of the new cafe.

name: Άγιος Έρωτας
summary: A charming young priest arrives in a small town, hiding secrets. His true purpose remains unknown until the powerful local leader's daughter unexpectedly becomes his greatest challenge.

name: Sword God
summary: Chief disciple Zhao Feiyang possesses the legendary "Nine Heavens Codex." When the Nether Hall wipes out the Heavenly Sword Sect, his meridians are shattered, and his fiancée even rips out his Dao bone and breaks off their engagement. At his darkest hour, he saves Bai Xi, an ancient demon saint, who grants him a saint-grade Dao bone, allowing him to cultivate again. Rising at an astonishing pace, he sets out to settle his old scores and found his own sect. A demonic sword recognizes him as its master, and even Earth Immortals submit to him. When the great tribulation finally descends, Zhao Feiyang stands defiant against fate and declares, "If Heaven demands that I face this tribulation, then I'll stain the heavens with blood!"

name: Μπαμπά σ'αγαπώ!
summary: Three special dads, Nikos, Dimitris and Iraklis, meet every day at the entrance of the kindergarten where they drop off their children, and begin to become friends and support each other in the incredible adventure called "fatherhood."

name: Σ'αγαπάω μεν... αλλά
summary: Paul and Daphne are a modern couple trying to solve all their problems without realizing that, if they ever did, life would be of no particular interest. times brings them to the brink of separation. But this couple together does not and apart can not! They separate, they find each other again, they separate again and the story goes on. As if their own problems were not enough, around them their families, their friends and their bosses, who despite their good intentions, create the biggest confusions.

name: Queridos Papás
summary: Four men meet in kindergarten with their children and share their stories and experiences as fathers in a world dominated by women.

name: Sres. Papis
summary: Three very different parents meet day after day at the door of a kindergarten, each have different difficulties. By sharing their experiences together they form a close friendship.

name: Σασμός
summary: Two families in conflict. An endless cycle of blood continues and the old vendetta wakes up like a nightmare. The memory of the dead demands revenge. Words have never had enough power to describe such extreme emotions. And somewhere there two young people experiencing love, come face to face with their feelings. Could love bring about reconciliation, the coveted "Jasmine"?

name: Kaiju No. 8: Narumi's Week at Work
summary: In a world plagued by creatures known as Kaiju, Kafka Hibino aspired to enlist in The Defense Force. He makes a promise to enlist with his childhood friend, Mina Ashiro. Soon, life takes them in separate ways. While employed cleaning up after Kaiju battles, Kafka meets Reno Ichikawa. Reno's determination to join The Defense Force reawakens Kafka's promise to join Mina and protect humanity.

name: Έρημη Χώρα
summary: Eva, a Greek-Romanian girl with a psychological speech impediment. Her world is shattered when a tragic accident claims the lives of her parents. Left with no one but her estranged grandfather, Lukas.

name: Mujer, casos de la vida real
summary: It is a Mexican series that shares real stories that have been sent to Silvia Pinal, the host of the show; the episodes deal with strong issues surrounding women that don't always end well.

name: Derbez en cuando
summary: Mexican TV-show about Mexican comedian Eugenio Derbez playing different characters.

name: María de todos los Ángeles
summary: A Woman named Maria de todos los Angeles is finding love. Until she meets a man named Albertano who may be the love of her life. But their relationship is complicated when Albertano family does not approve of Maria de todos Los Angeles

name: Radio Enfer
summary: Four high school students from different backgrounds run their school radio station while juggling academic, family, and social lives. Their clashing personalities create electric, explosive situations leading to humor.

previousepisode.name: La mariée avait les pieds gelés [2]

name: Vulnerables
summary: A therapy group led by Dr. Guillermo Segura (Jorge Marrale) is the meeting point of several patients with different problems.

name: Para vestir santos
summary: Three single sisters face new challenges after their domineering mother's death, including a battle with their stepsister over their childhood home, while struggling with their troubled romantic lives.

name: Μαύροι Πίνακες
summary: "The sleep of logic gives birth to monsters" Francisco Goya. A young schoolgirl, brutally murdered. A country town, full of secrets and lies. A ruthless killer who uses a chilling pattern. A race to catch him, before he strikes again.

name: Täiuslik sõbranna
summary: Three childhood friends are forced to reunite in order to solve the mystery of their missing friend.

name: Olacak O Kadar
summary: A comedy show about people's daily routines and life.

name: Ruhsar
summary: After her death, Ruhsar returns as a ghost to be with his husband Mazhar, but she must use her magical abilities to protect their happiness from Mazhar's mother, who is unaware of Ruhsar's presence, makes her best to remarry his son with another woman.

name: Sidika
summary: Sidika is the story of Saka family and their young daughter Sidika who live in a poor neighborhood of Istanbul. Sidika was not allowed to go to high school, raised to wait her husband-to-be at her fathers home, not even allowed to leave their house on her own. But she educated herself through books, newspapers and TV. She approaches her life, half-witted older brother, oppressive and alcoholic father and traditionalist mother in a satirical and fun manner along with the current political and sociological events of Turkey and the world. She gazes the world through her window as she hungers for all the intellectual accumulation of the universe.

name: Fairway of Love
summary: Nana, the daughter of a golf course tycoon, is suddenly called back from studying fashion in Europe to save the business from crisis. There, she meets Pro Vee, a former skilled golf pro who is now the resident golf pro. Pro Vee is strict, demanding, and displeased that Nana knows nothing about golf, the sport she loves and is so dedicated to. The two must cooperate to save Nana's father's golf course,leading to a deep and romantic relationship. However, things aren't as simple as they should be. A major obstacle hindering Nana and Pro Vee's goals is Pro Jin, another highly skilled golf pro from a rival golf course. This often leads to verbal clashes with Belle, Nana's father's secretary, who is sent to assist and be Nana's right-hand woman.

name: Ámbar
summary: Ámbar dreams of knowing her father, but what she has not realized is that her father's image is closer than she believes.

previousepisode.name: La boba de tu mejor amiga

name: Dadi
summary: After being fired from her job and dumped by her boyfriend, a cosmetics saleswoman becomes the nanny to the three children of a rich widow man. As time passes, the two fall for each other.

name: Papsid
summary: Aleks, Raivo, Marek and Toomas are modern-day men and fathers who face unexpected parenting challenges. Each of them solves the situations very differently, but together they successfully bring out the good and the bad of the modern parent. The stories of four friends are alive and definitely recognizable - there is also a lover, a breakup and other difficult relationship problems. How do men cope with all this?

name: Η Νταντά
summary: A woman decides to work as nanny in the house of a rich theater director and his three children.

name: Grand Hotel
summary: Kifissia, 1925. Petros Aslanoglou arrives at the Grand Hotel to visit his sister, who works there. Discovering she's been missing for over a month, he goes undercover as a waiter to investigate, soon finding himself in grave danger.

name: El hombre de tu vida
summary: An ordinary man and single father is about to see himself as an object of affection to hundreds of women after he accepts an unusual business proposition from his cousin.

name: Ricos y famosos
summary: Ricos y Famosos follows Valeria and Diego in the story of two families at odds, stemming from the conflict between Luciano, president of Salermo Bank and the distinguished academic Alberto García Méndez.

name: Kaygisizlar
summary: The story of Memnun, a carefree man, with 3 wives and 36 children.

name: Isla Paraíso
summary: The tranquility of an island where only men live, will be interrupted by the unexpected arrival of a group of women.

name: Juegos de Poder
summary: In a world of influences, political power and the search for justice, a confrontation is posed that brings with it a dilemma: how far one is able to reach by defending the sons and daughters.

name: Tough Love
summary: Tough Love follows a mother determined to prepare her three very unprepared adult children for life without her.

name: Pituca sin Lucas
summary: Tichi Achondo new status forces her to move from her super mansion in La Dehesa to a semi-detached house in a middle-class neighborhood.

name: Son de Fierro
summary: The experiences of the members of the Fierro family are narrated: Martín, the father; Lucía, the mother; Juan, who is blind and a teacher; Sandy, a showgirl; and Ezequiel, a street boy whom the family adopted.

name: Çemberimde Gül Oya
summary: Young journalist Feriha faces personal challenges while attempting to depict the violent era of 70s Turkey.

name: Minu kallis ema
summary: When the brutally murdered mother of drug addict Alina (30) is found on the beach one day, the question arises whether Alina is a coldblooded manipulator or a lifelong victim of abuse.

name: Το σπίτι δίπλα στο ποτάμι
summary: After her husband's death in 1942, a widow struggles to raise her five daughters on Mount Olympus, while years later changing lives and marriages pull the family away from their shared home.

name: Sres. Papis
summary: Sres. Papis chronicles the experiences of Favio "Chori" Carbonetti, Ignacio Moreno, Franco Bertossi, and Mauro De Leone—four attractive, modern dads who become friends through daily conversations at the school gate where their children attend preschool. Beyond supporting one another through the challenges and ups and downs of fatherhood, they find themselves drawn into each other's personal lives.

name: Deutschland, ich küss‘ dein Herz
summary: Tahsim Durgun embarks on the ultimate journey across Germany together with a Kurdish aunt who represents the generation of Tahsim's mother—a road trip spanning everything from high culture to hobby horsing, and from rural farms to the party scene of Ballermann. Along the way, he discovers that Germany is a multifaceted country, yet also one full of contradictions. Amidst the regulations governing allotment gardens and the roar of football stadiums, Tahsim attempts to introduce his Aunt Zeynep to the country.

previousepisode.name: In Berlin: Endspurt mit Ikkimel, Grönemeyer und Krömer

name: Pituca sin lucas
summary: Forced to reinvent herself, Techi moves with her mother and daughters to a modest middle-class neighborhood. There, she meets Manuel "El Tiburón" Gallardo, a single father and fish market trader; although they initially clash due to their cultural differences, an unexpected romance inevitably begins to blossom amidst the chaos and family comedy.

name: Pobre Gallo
summary: Nicolás Pérez de Castro, sick of stress, suddenly must go to the countryside to heal his illness.

name: Historias de sexo de gente común
summary: The series narrates the stories of sex that the common denominator of the people lives but does not dare to tell publicly. Focused on two young couples, through their marital stories and those of their other ties, the series presents a wide range of themes in terms of sex: infidelities, homosexuality, fantasies, swingers, parallel relationships, sexual inhibitions, frigidity, etc.

previousepisode.name: Historias de amor de gente común (parte 2)

name: Andy and the Band: Rock Star School
summary: Andy and the Band take on their new roles as teachers at Rock Star School but soon realise this is no ordinary school.

name: El cártel de los sapos
summary: Two good friends join the underground world of drug trafficking to make quick money and improve their lifestyles.

name: Love in Disguise
summary: An office romantic comedy that follows the story of a conglomerate heir and his new secretary, a former special forces officer now working undercover. Yun I Jun is a quirky third-generation chaebol raised in a sheltered environment who becomes a prime suspect in the mysterious murder of his previous secretary. When a new "male" secretary arrives to take the position, he has no idea that she's hiding a major secret. To uncover the truth, Kang Jae Hui, a former special forces officer turned police officer renowned as a "human weapon" for her exceptional strength and combat skills, disguises herself as a man and goes undercover as Yun I Jun's personal secretary and bodyguard. While protecting him, she secretly investigates him, setting the stage for unexpected chemistry, hidden identities, and plenty of comedic tension.

name: Papá a la Deriva
summary: Bruno, a widower and strict marine with 4 children, find love in a charismatic woman.

name: Papá en apuros
summary: Martín is faced with the challenge of raising his children alone, but he realizes that they also need a mother in their lives.

name: Son amores
summary: A single arbitrator who lives in Buenos Aires, where he unexpectedly is visited by his three nephews who lived in the village of Capitán Gómez, and his life changed forever.

name: Padre Coraje
summary: An idealistic man unknown to the townspeople is accused of murder. To avenge his name he pretends to be the priest and discovers a story full of betrayals and misery.

name: Süper Baba
summary: A family father struggles in maintaining lifelong relationships with three of his growing children ,after he divorced with his wife. In the unique Çengelköy district Fikret struggles with life, beside love, pain, hope.

name: Bir Demet Tiyatro
summary: The funny story of the Çitir Family and those around this family.

name: Extraordinary Attorney Minami
summary: Minamida Minami, who has autism spectrum disorder (ASD), graduates at the top of her class from the University of Tokyo's Faculty of Law and also achieves the highest score on the bar examination. However, when she begins searching for a job, she runs up against the barrier of society's prejudice toward people with autism spectrum disorder. Despite her outstanding credentials, she is unable to secure a position at any law firm. Then, for a certain reason, she is hired by Hirokawa & Howard Law Firm, one of the top firms in the industry. However, because Minami has difficulty reading other people's emotions and communicating with them, as well as adapting to unexpected situations, those around her view her with prejudice, believing that there is no way she could possibly deal directly with clients. Minami herself is also uncertain whether she is capable of working as a lawyer. Even so, armed with her love of the law and her extraordinary memory, and with the help of her colleagues, she takes on one difficult case after another. At the same time, a succession of events that profoundly shake Minami's life awaits her, including experiencing romantic feelings for the first time and discovering secrets hidden within her family....

name: Alibaba: Dastaan-E-Kabul
summary: Ali is a lovable rogue who prioritises his family. The 40 thieves, led by their leader Iblis, the devil incarnate himself, were suppressed by Ali's father, the great Jadugar Mustafa, and will remain so until two halves of a magical pendant unite. When the guardian of the cave, Simsim, embarks on a mission to resurrect the thieves, it is up to Ali, who holds one half of the magic pendant, to discover the magician within himself & realise his true purpose in life.

name: Azul tequila
summary: Brothers Arcadio and Santiago fight for control over their family's tequila empire. Arcadio marries Azul, who Santiago loves, to gain inheritance. Their wedding is interrupted by a peasant revolution, and Azul is kidnapped by gangsters.

name: Amor en silencio
summary: Marisela Ocampo is a wealthy, beautiful, and intelligent young woman who feels a great void in her life, but then she meets Fernando Silva, a good, honest man from a respectable family. The two fall in love, but their families oppose the relationship: on one side is Marisela's father, Miguel, who considers Fernando beneath his daughter and wants something better for her; on the other is Mercedes, Fernando's sister, who harbors an unhealthy love for her own brother and refuses to see him happy with any woman; and to make matters worse, Paola, Marisela's sister, becomes infatuated with Fernando and is unwilling to let her sister have him.

name: Súbete a mi moto
summary: The story revolves around 5 youngsters and the world of motorcycling; the title is inspired by a song from Hispanic group Menudo.

name: Sucupira: La Comedia
summary: A spin-off sequel of the 1996 TV series "Sucupira". The story takes place when Sucupira Mayor Federico Valdivieso, who was thought gone and buried comes out of his grave, causing confussion and chaos among the town's citizens.

name: Οι Βασιλιάδες
summary: The financially struggling Royals family's fortunes change when Markos Royal rescues a businesswoman who rewards him by making him chairman of her company.

name: Απαγορευμένη Αγάπη
summary: Two families, two worlds. On the surface, they are separated by a long distance, but in reality their destinies are closely linked and from a point on they become common. Dimitris and Alexandra are two young children, the former from a middle-class family, the latter a well-educated bigot. Their different upbringings do not stop the fatal attraction they feel as soon as they meet. The class difference would not be enough to keep them apart if the two children were not actually fraternal twins who were separated shortly after birth. Fate playing strange games brings Dimitris and Alexandra together. This event initiates rapid changes in the lives of the two families, since the guilty secrets, deep bitterness and intense loves of the past, buried for many years, now resurface.

name: O Machão - Um Exagero de Homem
summary: A Brazilian series, based on the play "The Taming of the Shrew" by William Shakespeare, which follows the story of Julião Petruchio, a rustic and determined man, and Catarina, a temperamental girl with an aversion to marriage.

name: Señores Papis
summary: Three fathers grapple with personal crises while navigating the challenges of parenthood and unconditional love for their children in the series Señores Papis.

name: Από ήλιο σε ήλιο
summary: Amid the 1916 miners' strike on Serifos, a young miner follows his father's path in the dangerous tunnels while falling in love with the daughter of his enemy, as workers rise to demand dignity and humane conditions.

name: Dos chicos de cuidado en la ciudad
summary: After moving from a rural village to the big city to live with their grumpy uncle, three siblings navigate urban life, pursue music careers, and cause comedic chaos while uncovering deep family secrets and finding love.

name: Το Τελευταίο Νησί
summary: After a tragic car accident claims the life of his longtime partner, a gifted medical graduate leaves everything behind to start over as a doctor on a remote island, where past and present begin to collide.

name: Το Απαραίτητο Φως
summary: Louiza Laskaratou, a successful professional living in the UK, is abruptly called back to Athens following the sudden death of her father. She then discovers an inheritance that forces her to question many facts of her family's history.

name: Sydney Harbour Cops
summary:
One of the world's most iconic harbours is also the scene of some of its most unpredictable police work.

Sydney Harbour Cops takes viewers beyond the postcard views and onto the water with the NSW Police Force Marine Area Command, offering unprecedented access to the officers charged with keeping Sydney Harbour and the NSW coastline safe.

name: I'm a Celebrity... The Wild Frontier
summary: Set in the untamed and rugged wilderness of Canada and in a big twist to the Australian version, this new spin off series will feature celebrities competing as pairs alongside relatives, loved ones or even fellow celebrities. The pairs will eat, compete and be eliminated together. Which pair will be victorious?

name: Μια νύχτα μόνο
summary: A devoted mother agrees to a painful bargain with a guarded businessman to finance her son's medical treatment, only for their forced encounter to ignite an intense and unexpected love that challenges both of their deepest wounds.

name: Porto Leone: Στη γειτονιά με τα κόκκινα φανάρια
summary: In 1960s Piraeus, two rival families are drawn into a destructive feud linked to the famed Porto Leone cabaret, where betrayal, forbidden ties, and hidden motives threaten to destroy them all.

name: Hack Along with GoldieBlox
summary: Hack Along with GoldieBlox is a girl-powered DIY web series where host Goldie Blox leads kids through fun, trendy crafts, cooking projects, and seasonal activities that secretly teach foundational STEM and engineering concepts.

previousepisode.name: 7 Ways to Upcycle Your Holiday Trash

name: Ο Τιμωρός
summary: What would you do if you lost everything in an instant? The love of your life, your father, your friends, your freedom? At twenty, Markos thought he had it all. Yet, those he trusted stripped him of everything, luring him into a deadly trap. Love, friendship, romance, betrayal, prison, money, power, revenge—varied emotions and circumstances, yet all ingredients of a life abruptly and treacherously severed in two by the ruthless hand of betrayal, only to be "reborn" two decades later with a different face and identity, but the same tormented soul.

name: Οι Αθώοι
summary: A disgraced woman finds refuge on the island to raise her son, Giannos. Intelligent and perceptive, he grows up bearing a stigma, as the villagers treat him with scorn and suspicion, regarding him as a "bastard" and an "outsider." In his heart, the purest of feelings awakens for a girl unlike the others of her time: Margarita.

name: Ο Δικαστής
summary: The career of the distinguished judge Petros Dimitriou seems to be heading for success, with a forthcoming promotion. Everything takes a turn after his teenage son, Alkis, is involved in a hit-and-run accident, for which he is responsible.

name: Το παιδί
summary: A fallen Taekwondo champion protects an autistic boy after his family is attacked, fleeing to her estranged mother's village, where buried secrets and a mysterious disappearance challenge their search for safety.

name: Paul C. Brunson: Red Flag
summary: Relationship expert Paul C. Brunson meets survivors of toxic relationships to reveal the red flags and warning signs that turned love into control, manipulation and abuse.

previousepisode.name: Gareth - Starved, Beaten and Treated Like a Criminal

name: Háblame de amor
summary: Following the tragic death of her parents in an attack fueled by obsessive love, a young woman returns years later to confront her past, unaware that the same silent enemy seeks to destroy her once again.

name: Wagging Rights
summary: Five celebrities and their dogs take on the world of competitive dog training, learning new skills, building on their relationships with their pets, and vying to be Wagging Rights champion.

name: Να μ' αγαπάς
summary: In Nafplio 2025, abandoned twins confront their mother - now married into a powerful family - forcing long-hidden secrets, forbidden loves, and a vengeful past to collide in a tale of betrayal and redemption.

name: Yasemince
summary: Yasemince delivers a routine family life of a hopeless middle class couple of which a housewife and a happy-go-lucky man struggle to adapt their lives into changing Istanbul metropolitan chaos. It is a comedy series that includes many sketches.

name: Yeditepe Istanbul
summary: When Olcay's husband commits suicide and leaves a huge debt behind, Olcay and her teenage daughter, Duru, are forced to move to a slum in Istanbul. They find themselves financially dependent on Olcay's only remaining friend, so Olcay starts to look for a job.

name: Los hijos de nadie
summary: Doña Leonor helps a group of homeless children. Verónica brings joy to street children with her puppets. Lucila hates children and their evils level up throughout the plot.

name: Gasoleros
summary: In January 1998, this slice-of-life series premiered, changing the way stories were told on local television and immortalising two beloved characters: Roxy and Panigazzi. Featuring memorable performances by Mercedes Morán and Juan Leyrado, Gasoleros, its title a distinctly local term, reflects Argentine customs, habits, and neighbourhood culture through characters representing everyday people in the country's society.

name: Alo
summary: A mockumentary about Alo and his colleagues at a highly competitive car dealership.

name: Pimeduses
summary: When the city goes dark - literally - newly divorced Andres is faced with painful choices: whether to give his children the chance to see their mother in another city, or to keep them away from a world that is falling apart by the hour.

name: Swalf Tafash
summary: A Bahraini comedy drama series, featuring different stories of life in the Gulf during the 1940s and 1950s, by presenting the simple life that people lived at this time.

name: Campeones de la vida
summary:
The series introduced audiences to the worlds of boxing, garbage collection, and meatpacking plant work, while also generating excitement through the palpable chemistry between the lead actors, a connection that transcended the screen in every scene they shared.

It gave rise to the unforgettable character of Guevara, a man striving to regain his standing in the boxing world, and Clara, a teacher grappling with her son's drug problem.

name: Cenas do Casamento
summary: Cenas do Casamento portrays the daily lives of three couples from different generations living in the same building.

name: Al norte del corazón
summary: A forbidden romance between two Mexican immigrants who cross illegally into the United States becomes complicated when she rises to fame as a music star and he is unjustly blamed for a crime.

name: Campeones de la vida
summary:
Rather than telling a single story, Campeones weaves together a series of interconnected tales based on the characters' family ties, friendships, and rivalries, aiming to paint a realistic portrait of a lower-middle-class neighbourhood in Mexico City. The situations presented are authentic and will resonate with viewers.

It tells the story of the Duarte brothers: Ciro, a traditional family man who is about to retire from his job as a meatpacker, and Chucho, a boxing promoter who tries to encourage his nephew Valentín - Ciro's son - to dedicate himself fully to the sport. Meanwhile, Valentín will experience a story of love and heartbreak between Carla and his true love, Isabel.

name: El cartel 2 - La guerra total
summary: Now Pepe Cadena finishes telling the story in which the most powerful drug traffickers in Colombia are strengthened but later fall while he and others dedicate themselves to the dangerous task of exposing them to collaborate with justice.

previousepisode.name: Los capos de capos caen pero quedan sus herederos

name: 13 Карт: Джокер представляет
summary: The card incarnations—the jacks and kings of the four suits—are confronted by a mystical force that reaches deep into their hearts. This force is the Joker, a mysterious and powerful card. Five animated stories await you: "Exchange," "The Knight of the Lucky Banner," "Ceiling," "All Inclusive," and "Endless." They appear completely different and disconnected (even executed in different artistic styles), but this is only at first glance... The characters of the "13 Cards" series are revealed in a new light. A more tragic and, most importantly, more personal side.

name: Nesmrtelní
summary: Nesmrteľní (Immortals) is a Slovak television series featuring modern adaptations of classic literary works brought into contemporary settings.

name: 22, el loco
summary: 22, el loco follows Federico Falcone, a police officer caught in a complex love triangle with Laura, a fellow brigade member he has known since childhood, and Ana, a progressive children's rights lawyer working at a home for underprivileged kids, amid a gritty story of family expectations, crime, and passion.

name: Tres son multitud
summary: The story centers on Roberto, a strict and methodical soccer referee who decides never to fall in love again after his breakup with Silvia. However, his life changes when he meets Lola—the wife of his rival, Guillermo—and then he is suddenly forced to live with three of his nieces and nephews: Mateo, Pablo, and Valeria.

name: Buen partido
summary: Roberto Sánchez, a soccer referee, falls in love with Patricia, a matron married to Guillermo Carmona, president of the referees' federation and his main rival. Unaware of her true identity, Roberto begins a romance marked by unexpected encounters, all while dealing with the arrival of his two nephews, who aspire to make it big in the capital's soccer scene.

name: El hombre de tu vida
summary: Hugo is a hardworking, honest widower raising his son on his own. Somehow, he begins working at a dating agency run by his cousin, where he must adopt various personas to win over different women.

name: Γιατί ρε πατέρα;
summary: A funeral, 3 half-siblings and 3 million euros. What could go wrong? When the well-known godfather of the night, Lefteris Tsatsanis, dies, he leaves behind absolute chaos. His legacy? A lost suitcase with 3 million euros and a hair salon.

name: η παραλία
summary: Doctor Ypatia returns to her village in '69, intending to announce her marriage. A tragic event upends her life, leading her to uncover family secrets and question her identity, desires when meeting the enigmatic doctor Harry.

name: Οι ατρόμητοι
summary: The Atromitos clan—always under the protection of the classic patriarch, Sotiris—are extreme, dynamic, feisty, passionate, hardworking, stubborn, and fiercely loyal to one another. They are a classic Greek family—the kind some people have, and others ardently wish they did. By following their story, we will learn to find joy, to love, to grieve, to fight, and to dream—in other words... to live!

name: Lovebites
summary: A micro-series centering on the lives of a young witty couple, Max and Katie.

name: De su misma sangre
summary: A young woman raised by a protective figure under difficult circumstances struggles to uncover her true identity and family origins, facing the prejudices of a rigid society and the complications of love amidst secrets from the past.

name: Εσύ αποφασίζεις
summary: In each standalone episode, viewers had the opportunity to influence the plot and choose the story's ending by voting via telephone.

name: Rhythm and Blooms
summary: Visiting botanical gardens across North America, with a soundtrack by contemporary jazz artists.

name: Takle mamo
summary: So it has come to this... is certainly the most common closing thought of three couples of different generations who each find themselves facing new challenges in life. Marija and Štefan are pensioners who often almost kill each other out of boredom. Darja and Tomaž are a middle-aged couple whose only son went to study abroad. Nika and Matic are a young couple who have just started their journey together. Nika is dominant and very disciplined, while Matic is a dreamer and an artistic soul. Which, of course, is the reason for many arguments.

name: Verdad consecuencia
summary: Seven childhood friends approaching the age of thirty attempt to maintain their emotional bonds while undertaking the drastic challenge of living their lives with absolute truth, regardless of the painful emotional, existential, and professional consequences this unleashes.

name: OJ Unseen: Exploitation of Evil
summary: Never-before-seen footage from O.J. Simpson's prank show reveals how a volatile comeback attempt unraveled. Mounting tension, uneasy encounters, and behind the scenes truths test the ethical boundaries of America's media machine.

name: 1776: American Independence
summary: The American Revolution erupts into a global war that reshapes empires. What begins as an anti-tax protest unfolds as a civil war, an uprising of an enslaved population, an Indigenous struggle for sovereignty and a world war that changes history.

name: Pleiades: Victims of a Serial Killer
summary: In 2019, the arrest of Cyprus' first serial killer, "Orestis," shocked the world. Nikos Metaxas targeted vulnerable migrant women, certain no one would notice their disappearance. The case broke when a body surfaced in a flooded mine shaft, exposing the murders of five women and two children. Through never-before-heard testimonies from first responders, investigators, journalists, families and experts, the series returns focus to the victims and the failures that hid the killer for years.

name: Зрители знают
summary: A group of studio audience members is split into opposing teams to compete in a fast-paced trivia challenge driven by lighthearted banter, humor, and general knowledge questions. Guided by expert quiz makers, the teams work together to solve quirky rounds, test their random facts, and score points, blending spontaneous comedy with competitive fun to determine which side comes out on top.

name: Super Animals
summary: Super Animals is a unique series that showcases the amazing 'superpowers' that animals possess. Profiling creatures of all shapes and sizes from environments all over the world, this series celebrates the endless, diverse array of life and astounding abilities to be found here on Earth. Comic book-inspired visuals enhance vivid wildlife footage of the animal kingdom strutting its stuff, while an original soundtrack and upbeat pace keep the facts and laughs flowing. Viewers will be awed by these incredible creatures and come away with a greater appreciation of the mysteries and marvels that the natural world holds. Every episode encourages co-viewing, conversation, laughs, and learning for kids and adults of all ages.

name: Найкращий поліцейський
summary: A police department eagerly awaits the arrival of a legendary, highly decorated detective named Oleg Korbut. Due to a clerical mix-up, a different man with the exact same name—Olezhka Korbut, a short, chubby, unluckily clumsy guy—arrives instead. When the real legendary cop arrives, both men are forced to team up as partners to solve dangerous and bizarre crimes together. Since there is only one open permanent slot at the station, the two must compete to prove who truly is the "best cop".

name: Side by Side With You
summary: Li Du grows from an aimless man into a responsible husband with Yang Ce's encouragement, and they find lasting love.

name: Escenas de Matrimonio
summary: The series tells the story of three middle-class couples navigating the conflicts, dramas, and joys common to any marriage.

name: Britain's TikTok Murder
summary: When a 62 year-old army veteran is found brutally murdered, suspicion falls on his influencer girlfriend after she posts a cryptic message on TikTok

name: Mannat - Har Khushi Paane Ki
summary: Abandoned by her mother, Mannat becomes a successful chef and finds love with Vikrant, only for destiny to separate them. Will she be able to reclaim her love?

name: Isla Paraíso
summary: Armando and Viviana were engaged and travelling on a cruise ship that suddenly sank. Maite (Viviana's sister) survived the wreck and spent a month on a deserted island with Armando; believing Viviana had died, she tried to seduce Armando, reasoning that the engagement no longer made sense. In reality, Viviana had survived and was on the other side of the island, being pursued by a cruel criminal, the man who had murdered her brother and sunk the ship because the police were after him.

name: Pablo: Next Level
summary: Pablo has started school. It's wild. It's wonderful. It's next level. From baffling rules to chaotic corridors, Pablo tackles it with imagination and help from his book animal friends.

name: Katha Ankahee
summary: Katha, a single parent, is in need of funds for her son's medical treatment. She comes across Viaan, who offers help but his conditions put her in an awkward situation.

name: Yeh Un Dinon Ki Baat Hai
summary: The story chronicles the adolescent romance between Naina and Sameer and explores the magic of 'first love' set in the city of Ahmedabad in the year 1990.

name: Dil Dosti Duniyadaari
summary: Fate brings together six people to Mumbai where they share a flat and become fast friends. They share in each others' joys and sorrows, and become each others' family away from home.

name: The Heroic Quest of the Valiant Prince Ivandoe
summary: The Heroic Quest Of The Valiant Prince Ivandoe follows Ivandoe, a young prince of the forest who has been sent on an epic quest by his father – The Mighty Stag to retrieve the magical Golden Feather from the Eagle King. Ivandoe is accompanied by his squire, a small bird named Bert, together they get into all kinds of silliness during their adventure while discovering new areas of the forest and encounter strange creatures on their journey.

previousepisode.name: The Prince and the Prom Date

name: Uff Yeh Love Hai Mushkil
summary: A headstrong woman raising her siblings butts heads with a cynical lawyer who distrusts women. Their fierce rivalry at home and court evolves into an unexpected path of love and healing.

name: Gruey
summary: Stephen Grucock is a disaster-prone schoolboy whose wild schemes constantly unravel into chaos. Alongside his loyal friends, his reckless escapades draw his rivals, long-suffering parents, and local neighbors straight into the fallout.

name: Julun Yeti Reshimgaathi
summary: After getting married, Supriya tells Ajit that she doesn't love him and is in relationship with someone else. Will Supriya realize the true meaning of love?

name: Los secretos de la cortesana
summary: In 18th century Spain, a court painter's daughter arrives at the royal palace and falls for the crown prince, who's returned home for an arranged marriage. Their forbidden romance stirs up dangerous passions and palace intrigue.

name: Itti Si Khushi
summary: After her mom's departure, Anvita takes care of her four younger brothers while juggling her personal life, love, friendships, and career goals.

name: Zung: The Rust
summary: In Alang's ship-breaking yards, Kaveri's perfect marriage conceals deadly secrets. An affair leads to blackmail and murder, triggering a police probe that unravels betrayal and manipulation. She faces the consequences of her choices.

name: The Legend of Karna
summary: A warrior from the Mahabharata who is born to Kunti and the Sun God Surya but raised in a charioteer's household. He possesses the gift of bow mastery that rivals the greatest warriors of his age, compelling him to enter a grand tournament usually reserved only for kings and princes, altering the course of an empire forever.

name: Looteri Dulhan
summary: Across the Hindi heartland, a suspended cop hunts a mysterious con bride who traps wealthy men through fake marriages.

name: Tu Juliet Jatt Di
summary: An ambitious girl, Heer and a privileged boy, Nawab from different worlds fall in love, but their story becomes marked by betrayal.

name: Mazhi Tuzhi Reshimgaath
summary: Yash, a rich and esteemed business tycoon, yearns for real love. While he falls in love with Neha, the journey ahead is not going to be an easy one for him. Will he be able to win Neha's heart?

name: Tula Pahate Re
summary: Wealthy loner Vikram falls for young employee Esha after helping her struggling family. They marry, but he keeps a mysterious locked room in his mansion.

name: Majhya Navryachi Bayko
summary: Mazhya navryachi bayko is a marathi romantic drama television series starring abhijit khandkekar, anita date and rasika sunil. The story revolves around gurunath who is happily married to radhika, until he falls in love with shanaya, a colleague. What would happen when radhika learns about this affair and what will be her move to save the marriage?

name: Swarajyarakshak Sambhaji
summary: Marathi TV Series on life of Great Chatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj.

name: A la deriva
summary: Héctor Parrado's boat sank with crew; no bodies recovered. Families left in limbo. Lucía, Maca, Rosa, Berta, Paloma bond through loss. Two years later, the five fishermen return alive, bringing joy, conflicts, and buried secrets.

name: Satrangi: Badle Ka Khel
summary: Witness the tale of Bablu, who is forced into Launda Naach, just like his murdered father. To what lengths will he go to avenge the wrongs that the powerful Singhs have bestowed on him and his family?

name: Raja Shivchhatrapati
summary: Shivaji Maharaj, born amid a failing kingdom, battled the Mughal empire and founded the Maratha empire, using strategic tactics to win battles despite being outnumbered.

name: Majha Hoshil Na
summary: Sai, who hails from a rich family, falls in love with an intelligent and righteous Aditya. They get married after overcoming several obstacles, but will Sai be able to deal with his family members?

name: Honar Sun Me Hya Gharchi
summary: Marriage brings spirited Janhavi into a mansion with six strong-willed mothers-in-law. Armed with grace and wisdom, she navigates complex relationships while staying true to her middle-class roots.

name: Jai Malhar
summary: This series is based on Lord Martanda Bhairava aka Khandoba, a reincarnation of Lord Shiva. The show is about Khandoba's courage, magnanimity and prowess. He is also fondly known as Malhar and worshiped across Maharashtra and beyond as the family deity of many. His devotees express their devotion by chanting aloud "Yelkot Yelkot Jai Malhar". The foremost center of Khandoba worship is Jejuri in Maharashtra and is thronged by huge devotees every year who visit to worship the Lord. Khandoba has been portrayed as a God of love, a Superpower and the symbol of excellence. He is portrayed as a super hero for the young generation.

name: Lagira Zhala Jee
summary: The story revolves around Ajinkya, a youngster from Satara, who aspires to join the Indian Army. He falls in love with Sheetal, a free-spirited girl, however, his aspirations come in between their love.

name: Tujhyat Jeev Rangala
summary: Tujhyat Jeev Rangala is the love story of Rana and Anjali. Rana is farmer and wrestler and while Anjali is a highly educated school teacher who has recently moved to the village. Their difference in mindset, upbringing and lifestyle makes their love story sweet and complicated at the same time.

name: Aggabai Sunbai
summary: Aggabai Sunbai is a Marathi family drama. While a coy and homely Asawari has evolved and is now a director of a renowned chain of restaurants, her irresponsible son Soham too.

name: Kahe Diya Pardes
summary: Gauri, a Maharashtrian girl from Mumbai, falls in love with Shiv, a North Indian. The couple soon gets married and relocates to the north. However, they face ups and downs in their lives.

name: Meet: Badlegi Duniya Ki Reet
summary: Despite her efforts to provide for her family, Meets disregard for societal gender norms and her nonconformist job as a delivery agent make her an unsuitable girl in the eyes of her family.

name: Gènesi
summary: Young Adrià arrives at El Bulli in the 1980s and meets Soler, beginning a creative transformation. In a parallel story, retired food critic Glòria returns from the U.S. after her father's death.

name: Prosjekt Dommedag: Gåten i Vanvikan
summary: One autumn day in 2013, a 15-month-old boy is found dead in Vanvikan. The parents' explanation of a comet and an imminent doomsday quickly arouses the police's suspicions: Could they have killed their own child? In this documentary series, TV 2's investigative journalists delve into the still unsolved case. The search for the truth uncovers new clues, and suggests that the answer to what really happened to the boy may have been there all along.

name: Dr.Aarambhi
summary: Once a great academic achiever, Aarambhi's life is now weighed down by marital responsibilities. However, she harbours a dream and longs to revive it.

name: Sairaab
summary: Follows two individuals from different worlds whose paths unexpectedly cross, one a pop star navigating fame and emotional turmoil, as they explore romance and destiny.

name: O Humnava Tum Dena Saath Mera
summary: Aparajita, an artist scarred by her past, crosses paths with Rakshit, a guarded businessman who's sworn off love. When two wounded hearts collide, can they find the courage to open up and let romance blossom?

name: Bareilly Ki Bachchan
summary: Young and ambitious, Sangam ends up marrying the carefree Krishna Bacchan. But the Bacchans have never lived with a woman, so how will the 'new Bahu' fare?

name: Service Girl
summary: A devastating viral video shatters Divya's reputation. Abandoned by friends and family, she pursues the truth behind the footage, only to discover a deadly criminal network that threatens her survival.

name: PSI Mangal Mukhi
summary: A transgender UP police officer, long mocked and marginalized, investigates a TV star's death on set. Diving into Mumbai's entertainment underworld, she exposes drug culture and hidden truths while fighting for justice and acceptance.

name: Brown
summary: Rita Brown, A disgraced alcoholic ex police officer and her mourning junior partner must confront their own personal struggles as they join forces to hunt down a serial killer targeting women from diverse backgrounds in Kolkata.

name: Yeh Fitoor Tera
summary: Saumya, a reclusive young woman burdened by traumatic past fears, lives a quiet life shielded from the world. Everything changes when she meets Jeet, a bold, free-spirited rebel who enters her life with fierce intensity.

name: Mr. and Mrs. Parshuram
summary: Shivprasad and Shalini juggle middle-class family life with their two kids. But hush. Shivprasad is also a secret agent, how long can he keep up his cover?

name: Rimjhim: Choti Umar Bada Safar
summary: Rimjhim's life is devoted to protecting her brother, Avik, as powerful relatives / villain conspire to use him as a pawn. She transforms from a devoted sister into a fierce guardian. Will Rimjhim be forced to sacrifice everything? Will love survive when everything is at stake?How far will she go to save Avik? Her struggle is universal even when the brother she's protecting cannot comprehend the pain she has endured for him.

name: Ishq Junooni
summary: A fateful accident binds two strangers in an unexpected marriage. He burns with desire, she's trapped by circumstance. As conflict tests their bond, they discover that fate's cruelest twist may lead to their greatest healing.

name: Lakshmi Niwas
summary: Born into wealth, Lakshmi chooses love over privilege and leads a life of sacrifice with Shriniwas. Years later, the couple still pursues a home of their own and their daughter's perfect wedding.

name: Kamali
summary: A kabaddi champion from rural Maharashtra rebels against family, pursues dreams in Mumbai, and promotes education to prevent child marriage while maintaining her cultural identity.

name: Savalyachi Janu Savali
summary: A dark-skinned singer Savali must let someone else claim her talent. Sarang, raised in a family focused on appearances, falls in love with her voice. Their marriage leads to consequences.
